description: Find the cheapest supplements by normalized price-per-unit within a category (and all its subcategories). This is the primary tool for "what is the cheapest X?" questions. Use list_categories first to pick a valid category_slug. Narrow it with filters (the category page's attribute filters, such as vegan or a form) and brand; every response lists the filters the category offers in available_filters.

brand.description: Optional: only this brand, by name or slug as it appears in the results.

category_slug.description: The category to search within, e.g. "whey-protein" or "creatine". Products in every subcategory are included, so a parent slug like "protein-powder" works too. Get valid slugs from list_categories.

filters.description: Optional: only products carrying every one of these attributes, the filters of the category page, e.g. ["is_vegan", "is_lab_tested", "form:powder"]. A boolean attribute is its key; an option is "key:value", one value per key. Every response lists the ids this category offers in available_filters; an id it does not offer is rejected.

in_stock_only.description: When true, only return products currently in stock.

limit.description: Maximum number of products to return (1-50).

market.description: Optional country market to query: nl, be, fr, gb, pl, es, dk, at. Defaults to nl, the market this endpoint answers for. Any other value is rejected.

name: find_cheapest
title: Find cheapest products
